name: dca-ai-plugins
description: Internal DCA Claude plugins maintained as code in the dca-ai repository.

plugins.name: dca-core
plugins.description: Core DCA source-routing and repository-navigation skills for Claude runtimes.

plugins.name: dca-relationship-data
plugins.description: Retrieve, add, correct, and reconcile DCA contacts, organizations, and relationship data using the current DCA Relationship Data Agent.

plugins.name: dca-logistics-intake
plugins.description: Capture mixed current Logistics-cycle evidence into bounded Airtable reconstruction/reconciliation staging while preserving provenance, operational context, and uncertainty without forcing a final model.

plugins.name: dca-needs-review
plugins.description: Packaged Claude capability for reviewing DCA Needs: guided, source-grounded review conversations producing proposals for joint review. Implements the provider-independent review-dca-needs workflow. Grants no data access or write authority by itself.

plugins.name: dca-fundraising-outreach
plugins.description: Prepare DCA fundraising and outreach communication for churches, Rotary clubs, donors, funders and partners: audience-specific emails, funding asks and applications, presentation material, replies, thank-you messages and follow-up, built from current DCA evidence and the latest sent newsletter campaign. Grants no data access, no send authority and no write authority by itself.

plugins.name: dca-donorbox-setup
plugins.description: Supervised DCA Donorbox page setup: generate a source-bound setup checklist for one page, stop for review, create a new campaign with the responsible person supervising and record what the UI actually shows. Implements the provider-independent set-up-donorbox-page workflow. Grants no data access, no publication authority and no write authority by itself.
